planets.name: TOI-1669 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1669 with a 2.68-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1669 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1669. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
